# NitroFusion2: Bringing Adversarial Loss to the Text Stream of Multimodal Diffusion Transformers

> NitroFusion2 is a 1–2 step text-to-image model built on Z-Image-Turbo, by Dar-Yen Chen and Yi-Zhe Song (2026). It applies an adversarial loss to the text stream of a multimodal diffusion transformer (MMDiT): mid-network text tokens have already read the image, so they serve as a discriminative representation. It produces fine detail in one or two steps.

- Text-Stream Adversarial Distillation (TSAD): uses intermediate text-token states of a frozen MMDiT discriminator as the adversarial representation, alongside image features.
- Aspect-Cued Discrimination (ACD): swapping the text condition (typography, objects, style, ...) steers which aspects the discriminator emphasises, with one backbone and no extra cost.
- Brings few-step distillation from 4–8 steps down to 1–2 steps at comparable quality; builds on NitroFusion (CVPR 2025).
- Released: bf16 weights, GGUF tiers (2.0–7.2 GB), a de-distillation LoRA for 2-step sampling, ComfyUI workflows, diffusers code, and an online demo. License: Apache-2.0.
